hostname ix-q02
!
ip access-list 101 permit ip src 192.0.2.0/24 dest any
ip access-list 110 permit ip src any dest 198.51.100.10/32
ip access-list cq2-udp5060 permit udp src any dest any dport eq 5060
ip access-list cq2-udp5060 permit udp src any sport eq 5060 dest any
ip access-list pq1-tcp23 permit tcp src any dest any dport eq 23
ip access-list pq1-tcp23 permit tcp src any sport eq 23 dest any
!
class-map match-any cq2-1
  match ip access-list 110
class-map match-any cq2-2
  match ip access-list cq2-udp5060
class-map match-any cq2-3
  match any
class-map match-any pq1
  match ip access-list 110 high
  match ip access-list pq1-tcp23 medium
  match any normal
class-map match-all rl-acl101
  match ip access-list 101
!
policy-map cq2
  class cq2-1
    bandwidth percent 50
    queue-limit 30
  class cq2-2
    bandwidth percent 25
  class cq2-3
    bandwidth percent 25
  class class-local
  class class-default
policy-map pq1
  class pq1
    queue-limit 30 40 50 60
  class class-local
  class class-default
policy-map rl-Gi0-1-in
  class rl-acl101
  class class-local
  class class-default
!
interface GigaEthernet0.0
  ip address 203.0.113.5/30
  service-policy enable
  service-policy output pq1
  traffic-shape rate 1536000 6144 0
  no shutdown
!
interface GigaEthernet1.0
  ip address 203.0.113.9/30
  service-policy enable
  service-policy output cq2
  no shutdown
!
interface GigaEthernet2.0
  ip address 192.0.2.1/24
  service-policy input rl-Gi0-1-in
  no shutdown
!
